messages:
PagerBot: :rotating_light: ALERT - log-based rule 'svc-model-5xx-rate' fired for model-serving-prod (5m window) - 5xx_rate > 5% | alert link: https://obs.example.com/alerts/98765
Aisha: taking this — I'm oncall for this shift, assigning to myself. starting quick triage. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Ben: on my way, grabbing logs and pod health. any obvious rollout just happened?
Aisha: nope no deploys in last 30m per deploy-bot. initial grep shows a surge of `grpc: connection reset` and `upstream EOF` traces from batcher-*.
Darya: CS: any user-facing errors reported? I've seen two tickets about elevated latencies but not full failures yet.
Aisha: impact looks partial — 15-25% of requests to eu-west cluster hit increased latency and occasional 502s, small set of customers affected. not a full outage. tagging CS.
Frank: can we spin up extra inference workers and fail traffic to fallback variant for affected routes? that should reduce retries.
Aisha: doing scale now — running: ```kubectl -n prod scale deployment/model-inference --replicas=20``` 
incident-bot: scaling action recorded by ops-runbook (runbook #sre-model-serve).
observability-bot: autoscale events: replicas 8 -> 20 completed (avg spin up 75s).
Ben: tailing logs now, there's a repeated noisy signature `client-handshake-timeout (code=GRPC_UNAVAILABLE)` that floods the rule. looks like intermittent upstream handshake flakiness that is expected briefly when a few hosts are unhealthy.
Aisha: ok, live mitigation: 1) scale up (done) 2) add temporary alert suppression for 30m to stop paging blast 3) tweak log query to filter the known noisy signature so we don't lose other signals.
Aisha: applying temporary suppression window: `alerts mute svc-model-5xx-rate --until 30m` — I'm adding a note to the alert.
PagerBot: :bell: Alert suppression applied by Aisha until +30m. Reason: mitigation in progress and noisy known handshake signature.
Ben: proposing permanent query tweak for after-incident remediation. Current rule uses: ```log_stream | where status >= 500 | count_over(5m) > 0.05``` I'm suggesting we add an exclusion clause to ignore transient client-handshake-timeout messages and a kv-cache-miss noisy pattern. new suggestion: ```log_stream | where status >= 500 and not (message =~ /client-handshake-timeout/ or message =~ /kv-cache-miss/) | count_over(5m) > 0.05``` ```Note: we add a tag 'known-noise' for excluded signatures.```
Aisha: I like that. let's also add a regex signature to our log rules so we can track how often we exclude these and not lose visibility entirely. add `signature: client-handshake-timeout` and `signature: kv-cache-miss`.
Darya: please capture customer impact summary for post-incident comms. small % of EU customers had degraded latency, no data loss.
Frank: creating remediation ticket SRE-3421 to: analyze root cause of handshake flakiness, add circuit-breaker on batcher side, and land alert-query change + dashboard. assigning to Ben.
Ben: will own SRE-3421, will push the query change behind feature flag and roll to prod after postmortem review.
Aisha: handing off watch to Ben in 18m — I'll stay around for the mute window. Ben, you'll take next oncall check at 1837781000.
Ben: ack — will keep eyes on the metrics and unmute when safe.
Aisha: quick note for the runbook: when you see this pattern, don't page infra on first burst; instead validate upstream host health and scale fallback. adding that as a runbook bullet. :memo:
observability-bot: Created temp dashboard: https://obs.example.com/dashboards/serving-quickview (shows filtered 5xx rate, handshake signature counts, region breakdown).
incident-bot: Post-incident tasks created: SRE-3421 (owner: Ben), CS-1705 (owner: Darya) for external comms.
Ben: pushed a draft of the updated query to the alerts repo in PR #458, includes signed regex and metric to count excluded matches so we can alert if exclusion rate climbs.```diff
- where status >= 500
+ where status >= 500 and not (message =~ /client-handshake-timeout/ or message =~ /kv-cache-miss/)
```
Aisha: :white_check_mark: Verified traffic rerouted and latency improving in eu-west. Suppression expires in 17m; Ben if all good please unmute earlier.
Ben: will monitor, if stable I'll remove suppression by 1837780500 and merge PR after 1h observation.
Darya: thanks — I'll prep a one-paragraph update for affected customers summarizing impact and mitigation.
PagerBot: :rotating_light: ALERT - svc-model-5xx-rate still firing for a small shard (follow-up alert), but excluded-signature count increased. Added note to SRE-3421.
Aisha: following up: we've limited noise, scaled capacity, and created changelist + ticket. handing complete. signing off. :raised_hands:
Ben: handover complete — taking oncall watch. final note: keep the exclusion regex conservative, we'll iterate postmortem. :eyes:
